review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines only Prop-valued statements: RiemannInequality, RiemannIndexFormula, WeilDualityAdelic, WeilDuality, WeilOmegaEllAgrees and FunctionFieldRiemannRoch. It also has two short linarith-based implication theorems. A case-insensitive search of Mathlib for "Riemann-Roch" or "RiemannRoch" found nothing. The notions the statements use (divisors, genus, ell, canonical divisor, places, adelic index) come from the project's imported files. They are not defined here, so they do not compete with Mathlib in this file. I did not check whether those imported files duplicate Mathlib concepts. The statements are specific named propositions, not reimplementations of existing Mathlib concepts. I found no justified finding under this rubric.
